lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，壳擦过沙。
lines.en: I walk low, my armour scraping sand.
My back is all hard plating.

lines.zh: 尾巴末端的甲板一晃一晃。
lines.en: The plate on my tail sways.
I'm not fast, but steady.
The riverbed's dry and crusty under me.
I leave a furrow in the dune.
The rings on my neck shift.
I skirt a clump of dead grass.
I stop, one ear turned.
All four feet carry buried claws.
I follow the old channel down.

lines.zh: 沙软的地方我先试一步。
lines.en: Where the sand's soft, I test a step.
The sun's hard; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 走一步，身上的甲响一下。
lines.en: Each step, the plates click.
I pick the flattest line.
I won't be hurried.
I lie down, belly on the sand.
A little sand got in my ear.
I'm watching the far dunes.
My tail taps the ground.
The plates are hot in the sun.
I scratch at the sand.
Wind blows sand onto my back.
I'm listening to the ground.
Something small moves far off.
I draw my neck in.

lines.zh: 背上十点护甲，我懒得快。
lines.en: Ten armor on my back. I see no reason to hurry.
A stone digs into me.
I shift position slowly.
You're standing on my ground.
I raise my head, plates bristling.
I'm not tall, but I'm heavy.
You're too close to my nest.
A note rumbles in my throat.
I don't like being patted on the head.
There's a plate at my tail's end.
I'm shielding the pit behind me.
You've got some nerve.
I grunt and step back.
It doesn't hurt much; I'm just annoyed.

lines.zh: 我背上这层甲，弓起来像座小山。
lines.en: My armored back arches like a small hill.
My tail lashes once.
I kick up sand.
I turn slowly to face you.
That won't get through the plates.
I make a low sound.
I don't intend to leave.
That in your hand is a plant.

lines.zh: 沙丘上的甲龙，慢慢转过尾锤。
lines.en: The ankylosaur on the dune slowly swings its tail club.
It smells acceptable.
Put it on the ground.
I stretch my neck for it.
I won't eat it too dry.
A crisp mouthful.

lines.zh: 装甲鳞甲下，我嚼得很慢。
lines.en: Beneath my armored scales I chew slowly.
If there's more, set it down.
I wait till you set it down.
You hit my armoured back.
Not one plate shifted.

lines.zh: 我的甲片把你的手弹开了。
lines.en: My plates bounce your hand off.
The ground compresses.
I shift my body toward you.
You back off; then I stop.
Sand kicks up between us.
That wasn't a real hit.
My centre of gravity is low.
I'm hard to push.
She's in the pit behind me.
She taps my armour with her tail.
We scrape at the sand together.

lines.zh: 我把最嫩的植物让给她。
lines.en: I give her the tenderest plants.
The pit deepens.
Her plates are darker than mine.
At night she leans against me.

lines.zh: 这是我的伴，你最好退后。
lines.en: That's my mate—best step back.
I scrape the sand and find something.
It sticks between my claws.
Not food; I drop it.
This dead branch has some moisture.
Too heavy; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 尾锤一扫，那东西滚下沙坡。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail club sends it rolling down the dune.
It rolls down the slope.

lines.zh: 你脚边那块，是我先看中的。
lines.en: That piece by your foot—I saw it first.
The sand ahead is moving.
I stop and lift my head.
My tail starts to swing.
It's too close to my nest.
I settle onto all four feet.
My plates all stand up.
I walk toward it, slowly.
The sand sounds under me.
I'll use this to ram.
The club on my tail is still there.
I came on anyway.
I follow, step by step.
It's faster than me.
It went round the dune.
I go the other way.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴末端抬起来了。
lines.en: My tail tip lifts.

lines.zh: 十点护甲的我，一步步压过来。
lines.en: With ten armor, I press forward step by step.
It ran into my flank.
It backed behind a pile of stones.
I press toward it.
This time I'll land it.
It has nowhere left.
I ram head-first; sand bursts up.
A swing of my tail lands the plate.
It's shoved a long way back.

lines.zh: 这一下用了我全部重量。
lines.en: That one used all my weight.
A dull crack comes from it.
I step back and watch.
Sand buries half of it.
There's blood on my plates.
I stop moving.
I turn and shield the nest.
I stand, breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 干河床上多了一团影子。
lines.en: A new shadow on the dry riverbed.
My back plates show first.
My feet press marks into the sand.
The wind here carries sand.
I look around, slowly.
Dry beds here; good.

lines.zh: 干涸河床下，我抖落一身沙。
lines.en: Under the dry riverbed I shake off a coat of sand.
My plates knock together.
Animals walk in the distance.
I pick a flat spot and stop.
The nest isn't dug yet.
I start scraping sand.
The sun is overhead.
I hear my own plates clicking.
I lower my head for a bite.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，缝里发烫。
lines.en: Fire heats my plates; the seams burn.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，甲先着地，闷响。
lines.en: I land on my plates with a thud.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我挣着往上。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I struggle up.

lines.zh: 炸响把我推得侧了过去。
lines.en: The blast shoves me sideways.

lines.zh: 有股力量把我压向地面。
lines.en: Something presses me to the ground.

lines.zh: 沙丘的草太干，我饿得发沉。
lines.en: The dune grass is too dry; hunger weighs me down.

lines.zh: 雷打在甲上，我四条腿都麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my plates; all four legs numb.
No sand left; I keep falling.
